title: Read ordered waves without creating implicit wave barriers
preconditions: Create earlier wave order 10 and later wave order 20; put incomplete item A in earlier and independent item B in later; both items have one definition and progress head and no explicit dependencies.

steps.action: Query waves and work-items through every page.
steps.expected_result: Wave order is earlier then later and each item exposes its assigned wave identity.

steps.action: Read work-items for B while A remains incomplete.
steps.expected_result: B is ready and has no dependency blockers; earlier-wave progress has no effect.

expected_result: Waves coordinate ordering without becoming dependency gates.
